mandate_phase: Phase 2 - audit what biological truth is actually planted

measured_on.source: locally regenerated and SHA-256 verified against CI run 37252622570

THE_COMPLETE_PLANTED_TRUTH.how_they_are_drawn: every dimension is an independent standard normal keyed by (seed, global_cell_index, stream) via stateless SplitMix64. There is no covariance, no hierarchy, no mixture and no group structure among them

RECOVERABILITY_MATRIX.method: linear oracle probe, 50/50 held-out split, seed 20261005, CPM-log1p features. This is an upper bound for linear readout and a reference for any learned model

THE_CEILING_FROM_THE_PERMITTED_RNA_VIEW.statement: even a perfect linear reader of the 96-gene view recovers about 0.67 of each shared latent, not 1.0. Anything above that must come from nonlinearity, not from more data

mandate_phase3A_categories.note: there is no PARTIALLY recoverable component. The world is sharply bimodal: a factor is either ~0.67 recoverable from RNA or exactly 0.00. No intermediate case exists, so the world cannot calibrate a partial-recoverability metric

D1_inert_truth_dimensions.finding: technical_latents[1] and technical_latents[2] are consumed by NOTHING
D1_inert_truth_dimensions.consequence: 2 of 14 planted truth dimensions are inert. They inflate the apparent dimensionality of the ground truth and would make any 'fraction of truth recovered' metric wrong by construction unless they are excluded

D2_private_biology_and_private_technical.finding: technical_latents[0] and z_reg_private enter ATAC identically and have identical recoverability signatures
D2_private_biology_and_private_technical.consequence: a model that recovers an ATAC-private factor cannot be shown to have recovered BIOLOGY rather than a technical effect, because the world makes them structurally identical. This directly undermines the mandate's Phase 3G cross-modal semantic validity test
D2_private_biology_and_private_technical.severity: HIGH for any cross-modal biological-meaning claim

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: z_global, 4 i.i.d. N(0,1) dims per cell; enters FULL104 RNA, multiome RNA and ATAC through dense linear maps then exp link
no discrete types, no mixture component, no cluster structure anywhere in the generator

evidence.interpretation: every planted latent is a unimodal Gaussian; there are no states to belong to

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: latents are keyed by (seed, global_cell_index, stream) ONLY. donor_index is assigned by a separate population-geometry routine and never enters any latent

evidence.interpretation: observed ICC equals the pure-independence expectation; two cells from the same donor have independent biology

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: no mixture, no heavy tail, no outlier class, no low-prevalence program

evidence.interpretation: the tails are exactly Gaussian. There is no rare biology to detect, so this world cannot test rare-state sensitivity at all

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: no time, pseudotime, trajectory or lineage variable exists in the truth or any observer
z_query, 2 dims, is RNA-private: it enters FULL104 RNA and multiome RNA but not ATAC. It is NOT query-conditional - it passes through the same global linear map as z_global with no locality mechanism
INVENTORY.note: named 'query' but operationally it is an RNA-private GLOBAL factor. No local/query-conditional effect is planted anywhere

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: all loading matrices are dense Gaussian: FULL104 W is 9x96 at scale 0.22, multiome Wr 11x64 at 0.20, Wa 12x256 at 0.18. Every latent loads on every feature

evidence.interpretation: no marker genes, no sparse programs, no feature selection structure

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: eta = latent @ W is strictly linear in the latents; exp() is a monotone link applied to the SUM, not an interaction term

evidence.interpretation: programs combine multiplicatively on the relative-abundance scale purely as a consequence of the exponential link. No interaction coefficient is planted, so a model cannot be credited or penalised for capturing one

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: z_reg_shared (3 dims) drives RNA and ATAC; z_reg_private (2 dims) drives ATAC only
INVENTORY.note: this is LATENT SHARING between modalities, not a regulatory mechanism. Nothing regulates anything

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: 7 dims (z_global 4 + z_reg_shared 3) are common to RNA and ATAC; same-cell pairing is exact and asserted by the generator
no transcription factors, no motifs, no peak-to-gene links, no regulon graph

evidence.atac_regions: a uniform 5 kb tiling of chr1: REGION_START = arange(256)*5000 + 1,000,000
evidence.interpretation: region coordinates carry no biological adjacency, so no cis-regulatory question is expressible

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: the V75 biology_positive control adds a fixed +1.0 to z_global[0] for cells where global_cell_index %% 4 == 0
INVENTORY.note: a single mean shift on one coordinate that is ALREADY the most recoverable thing in the world. There is no causal graph, no dose, no downstream cascade and no off-target structure, so it cannot support any causal qualification

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: no coordinates, no neighbourhood, no niche or context variable exists
operator determines the structural availability mask and the depth/detected-support quantiles, calibrated from frozen 50k operator-level QC summaries

evidence.interpretation: availability is a DETERMINISTIC function of operator. This is the strongest single structure in the world

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: a 2-dim source embedding enters multiome RNA and ATAC; source quotas are calibrated to the authenticated FULL104 population geometry

evidence.caveat: source does NOT enter the 96-gene FULL104 observer's biology at all; there it acts only through operator nesting

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: per-operator library-size and detected-feature quantiles, coupled by a Gaussian copula using the within-operator log1p-library-vs-detected Pearson as rho

evidence.interpretation: depth is drawn from a stream outside the truth object, so it is structurally independent of biology

INVENTORY.mechanism_in_generator: per-operator availability mask projecting measured_scalar_addresses/41238 onto the 96 panel slots; the generator asserts that unavailable features receive zero counts
availability and depth are computed without any reference to the biological latents

evidence.interpretation: the generator ASSUMES the observation operator is independent of biological state. The mandate names this as something not to assume, and the world currently cannot test it

CAN_TEST: recoverability ceilings from a partial RNA view, with an exact known answer
that a genuinely RNA-non-recoverable factor (z_reg_private) is NOT falsely reported as recovered
rejection of technical shortcuts: operator, source, depth and structural missingness are all strong and known
sensitivity to a known planted mean shift
measurement-realization stability under a fixed observation operator
CANNOT_TEST: rare biology - none is planted; the tails are exactly Gaussian
cell types or states - none are planted
donor biology - donor ICC equals the independence null
local or query-conditional effects - z_query is global despite its name
sparse marker programs - all loadings are dense
nonlinear program interaction - the model is linear in the latents
regulatory mechanism or SCENIC+ structure - no TF, motif or peak-gene link exists
causal perturbation response - one mean shift on the most recoverable coordinate
spatial or context effects - none exist
biology x operator interaction - measured independent by construction
technology transport - the measurement null holds the operator mapping identical
WHAT_THIS_WORLD_CAN_AND_CANNOT_TEST.bearing_on_the_premise_question: the premise asks which biological state is recoverable from partial RNA and what representation structure preserves common AND rare biology. This world can answer the recoverability half for COMMON biology and can police technical shortcuts. It cannot address rare, local, sparse, interacting or regulatory biology at all, because none of it is planted

scope: an inventory of what is planted and a measured recoverability ceiling. It qualifies no representation, no target and no biology, and makes no claim about real data
